notes.title: PatchNotes 10/21/2018
notes.notes:
Added Features:
*Added save game - Continue your progress anytime you want
*Remove the force combat - Fighting the mini-boss is now optional
*Non-combat controls - During Non-combat(shield is on the back) character will face 
the movement directio.
*Added intro.

Minor bug:
*Fix the bug for the enemy sliding when running towards the player
